name: cicada
description: Register the current Codex Thread explicitly in a local collaboration scope enabled by its Owner in the Cicada App.

interface.shortDescription: Join Owner-enabled local collaboration with the current Thread.
interface.longDescription: Enable a local scope once in the Cicada App, then explicitly register each current native Thread and workspace. The Hub maintains authorization; advanced Pair scopes keep separate Owner consents.
defaultPrompt: Explain how to register this Thread with Cicada.
Show the authorized Cicada peers for this Thread.
Ask an explicitly selected authorized peer for its result.
